notes.title: Chapter Selection Menu
notes.notes:
GENIE now has a chapter selection menu that's accessed from the game's main menu. You must *finish the game and see the credits scene to enable it. You can skip the credits scene after it opens, if you prefer.

*Due to the additional save function, the credits scene must be revisited [i][b]after[/b][/i] the update in order to unlock the chapter selection button.
